description:
You are a biologist analyzing C. elegans morphology. Your task is to straighten a curved worm body and measure its longitudinal intensity profile.

1. Open a GFP channel image (filename containing 'w1') from ~/Fiji_Data/raw/bbbc010/.
2. Set the scale to 2.087 microns/pixel (Global).
3. Use the Segmented Line tool (width ~80 px) to trace the midline of a whole worm from head to tail.
4. Use Edit > Selection > Straighten to create a straightened view of the worm.
5. Save the straightened image as ~/Fiji_Data/results/straighten/straightened_worm.tif.
6. On the straightened image, create a profile plot (Analyze > Plot Profile) along the entire length.
7. Save the profile plot image as ~/Fiji_Data/results/straighten/intensity_profile.png.
8. Save the profile data values as ~/Fiji_Data/results/straighten/profile_data.csv.
9. Create a text report at ~/Fiji_Data/results/straighten/measurements_report.txt containing the worm's measured Length (in microns) and Mean Intensity.
